[[Edielh's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Edielh Shockhunter]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Jaga Moraine]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Air Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of Air Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of Air Magic spells (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Storm Artifact]] from collectors [[Cinder Linnwood]], [[Ornhelm Brightaxe]], or [[Farrer]] or crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]]
OR
*[[Storm Artifact]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription#Forget Me Not|Forget Me Not]]" inscription
AND
*Purple [[dye]]
